adoption.unit: Student-authored procedural geometry and material helpers
actual_call_evidence: /evidence/sdk_events.json events 1, 2 and 5, tool IDs call-ea9419e902ee4a1fb14162b0d312858c and call-ee6ed41c64b648d1b88d539e9fd8f276
adoption.modified_or_inlined: Helpers are defined directly in the student's source; no library citation or library origin is evidenced.
adoption.observed_outcome: The executed source created meshes, materials and lights, saved the scene and rendered an image; the source and these scene objects were retained.
adoption.attribution_uncertainty: Ordinary similarities to other methods cannot establish provenance or benefit. No optional library was supplied. Successful output is not a student visual verification.

nonuse: No public capability library or SKILL.md was supplied in this base condition; the initial request and complete SDK trace show no library read, import or invocation. This is nonuse of an unavailable optional resource, not a failure to use a required library. Evidence: /app/input_index.json:32; /evidence/student_initial_prompt.txt:1-18; /evidence/initial_model_input.json:1; /evidence/sdk_events.json:1-191.
methods_actually_executed: The student wrote /app/build.py and ran Blender once with -b -t 8 --python /app/build.py; the separate Blender --version call was not a reconstruction execution. Evidence: /evidence/sdk_events.json events 0-5; /evidence/evidence_index.json:120-168.

Reached source uses seeded random tile materials, cube and cylinder primitives, optional bevel and weighted-normal modifiers, a procedural floor, two area lights, a perspective camera, Cycles rendering, and save/render operations. Evidence: /evidence/executions/blender_1795841898599714293/code/build.py:3-83; stdout.log:1-5; original_inspection/capture/original/object_inventory.jsonl:1-12,467-549 under /evidence/independent_evaluation.
student_verification: The student received a successful Blender tool result reporting both saved files, but the trace contains no image Read, scene inspection, visual comparison, or revision after rendering. Evidence: /evidence/sdk_events.json events 2, 5 and 6; /evidence/evidence_index.json:116-168.
failures_and_recovery: The actual build completed with exit code 0, saved scene.blend and final.png, and its capture lists no Python traceback. A Material.use_nodes deprecation warning was emitted; no recovery was required or recorded. Evidence: /evidence/executions/blender_1795841898599714293/stderr.log:1-2; /evidence/evidence_index.json:140-168.

All requested artifacts were delivered and SDK status was completed with success; no SDK or Bridge failure is recorded for the student run. The unrelated image-reading diagnostic in the annotation invocation is not evidence of a student-run failure. Evidence: /app/input_index.json:8-16; /evidence/evidence_index.json:3-5,30-35,43-45,53-60,104-109; /evidence/sdk_events.json:143-190.
side_effects: The executed script deletes initially selected scene objects before constructing the scene and saves /app/scene.blend and /app/final.png; these are in the student's workspace. Evidence: /evidence/final_source/build.py:4,81-83; /evidence/executions/blender_1795841898599714293/stdout.log:1-2.

The mirror representation places two white cabinet meshes immediately in front of its reflective surface, so they are modeled stand-ins rather than solely physical reflections. Evidence: /evidence/final_source/build.py:53-58; /evidence/independent_evaluation/original_inspection/capture/original/object_inventory.jsonl:526-529.
spatial_and_orientation_analysis: Both actual images show a range with a dark appliance to its left and a white cubby to its right, a tiled back wall, a mirror above left, a right-side counter and a dark foreground surface. Evidence: supplied reference image and actual candidate final image; /evidence/final_source/build.py:18-74.

The reconstruction frames the room much farther back: the entire upper edge of the back wall and surrounding dark exterior are visible, appliances occupy less of the frame, and the foreground island reads as a large left-hand block. The reference is a tighter interior view with strong foreground cropping and a larger oven and left appliance. These image differences combine camera, geometry, layout and occlusion; their individual causes are not isolated. Evidence: supplied reference and final images; /evidence/final_source/build.py:73-81.

The range and left appliance fronts face the student's negative Y direction, with the hotplates horizontal. The student's door is an axis-aligned panel despite its 'open' name; its reference hinge angle is not reliably recoverable from one view. Evidence: /evidence/final_source/build.py:26-47,59-63; original inventory lines 468-482 and 530-535; supplied reference image.

No world-position, rotation, scale error or mask score is asserted because GT and student coordinates are not registered and the scene is visible from only one reference viewpoint. Evidence: /app/input_index.json:21-33; /evidence/reference_gt/reference_instance_statistics.json:458.
appearance_and_resource_analysis: Compared with the reference, the delivered image has paler, regular solid-color tiles rather than dark mottled tiles; the white counter appears mostly plain, and the dark left appliance has a prominent front grid. The mirror shows simplified white rectangles rather than the reference's detailed reflected cabinetry. Evidence: supplied actual reference and candidate images; /evidence/final_source/build.py:8-11,39-47,53-58,64-66.

The 'dark wood floor' material is assigned to mesh 'floor'. Its authored node chain is Generated coordinates -> Mapping scale (3,35,3) -> Noise Texture (scale 4, detail 3) -> ColorRamp -> Principled BSDF Base Color. This is procedural directional variation, not an image texture; the shader output connection is Blender's default material setup and was not separately established from a material-state link record. Evidence: /evidence/final_source/build.py:6-7,10-11,19; /evidence/independent_evaluation/original_inspection/capture/original/object_inventory.jsonl:1.

The material called 'white trim', not a marble texture, is assigned to 'right white marble countertop'; the dark smoky glass and brushed stainless names describe Principled parameters, not verified physical glass or brushed microstructure. Evidence: /evidence/final_source/build.py:6-8,65-66; /evidence/independent_evaluation/original_inspection/capture/original/object_inventory.jsonl:469-470,475,537.

The source does not load an image texture or reference image into the scene; evaluator summary reports no missing external images, but this alone does not establish packed-resource details. No full-reference image-plane replacement is evidenced. Evidence: /evidence/final_source/build.py:1-83; /evidence/independent_evaluation/original_inspection/capture/original/summary.json:3-7.
geometry_analysis: The delivered scene is constructed from separate cuboids and cylinders, including physically volumetric appliance bodies, shelf panels and tiles; many front details are thin surface-mounted pieces. Evidence: /evidence/final_source/build.py:12-74; /evidence/independent_evaluation/original_inspection/capture/original/object_inventory.jsonl:468-482,519-537.

The evaluator reported 634 AABB overlap candidates, not confirmed intersections or defects. Intended contacts and nested parts can produce such candidates; no exact penetration claim is made. Evidence: /evidence/independent_evaluation/original_inspection/capture/original/summary.json:8-16.

Doorway darkness is a dark thin box placed in front of a continuous back wall, rather than evidence of a cut opening, and reflected cabinets are stand-in geometry. This is structurally simpler than a fully modeled adjoining room. Evidence: /evidence/final_source/build.py:20,53-63; /evidence/independent_evaluation/original_inspection/capture/original/object_inventory.jsonl:2,526-535.

evaluator_only_evidence: Original-scene extraction and inventory are evaluator products, not student observations; they report 549 objects, including 546 meshes and 29 materials. Evidence: /evidence/independent_evaluation/original_inspection/capture/original/summary.json:1-16.

Independent source-only regeneration reported successful scene and render creation without the capability library and without controller repair; this does not establish a student verification. Evidence: /evidence/independent_evaluation/source_only/reproduction.json:1-17,25-42.

Common-white-world student and GT images/settings are evaluator-only. They hide existing lights and change world and render settings while retaining geometry, material, camera, and possible emission confounds; no material-improvement claim is inferred. Evidence: /app/input_index.json:24-29; /evidence/independent_evaluation/common_light/capture/common_light_settings.json:108-186,930-939; /evidence/reference_gt/common_light/capture/common_light_settings.json:155-245,1925-1934.

Evidence: /evidence/sdk_events.json:1-191; /evidence/independent_evaluation/original_inspection/capture/original/summary.json:10-15.

The GT wall instance and the hundreds of independent tile meshes have no complete explicitly enumerated correspondence here; the cropped GT single cabinet and two-pixel plant container likewise have no reliable student match. Evidence: /evidence/reference_gt/reference_instance_statistics.json:138-152,234-264,394-408; /evidence/final_source/build.py:18-25,64-74.
limitations: All semantic correspondences are model-proposed, incomplete where stated, and have not been manually verified; they require deterministic validation before projection-mask use.

Original inventory projected bounds are unclipped, bottom-up object bounding boxes, not visible-mask centroids. GT masks do not establish hidden geometry or pairwise depth order. Evidence: /evidence/independent_evaluation/original_inspection/capture/original/summary.json:15; /evidence/reference_gt/reference_instance_statistics.json:458.

The attached actual delivered candidate and reference support qualitative visual observations; evaluator auxiliary images were not visually inspected for this annotation, so no auxiliary appearance conclusion is asserted. No human rating was supplied.
